item.title: Nearly 3,000 smoke dectors installed in Memphis in 3 days
item.description: MEMPHIS, Tenn. -- Thousands of Memphians can sleep a little sounder after Memphis firefighters personally installed smoke detectors in their homes last weekend. The Memphis Fire Department said 2,895 free smoke alarms were mounted during a smoke detector and fire safety blitz across Memphis from February 13–15.
